## Native receiving update — 11 November 2026

The frozen R2 receiver passed all eight 50-update engineering profiles, including full-state reload checks on both ranks. ROOT admitted and launched four fresh, fixed-E4, two-rank fits from source `8626000a4b965763a70011a0291a891aa6535d7e` (capsule SHA256 `931a91046efb0f84e68184862e80076bb2751522bc6264fffa06e3cab36931fd`; admission SHA256 `849b396a54c2e4ffbc5eeff572ddbcbb1921bdd019999fa951062ae28b815dc6`).

The last transferred native progress snapshot is **2026-11-11 02:10:51 UTC**: `plain_s203301` 883/3280, `plain_s203302` 890/3280, `rms_s203301` 912/3280, `rms_s203302` 919/3280. ROOT subsequently reported both SSH streams lost after the VPN connection disappeared; bounded reconnect attempts timed out. Current fit liveness and resources are unverified. No terminal fit grades or quality score are claimed.

A bounded no-new-fits waiter was launched against the original 06:10:28 UTC collection deadline. It will only start canonical standalone full-validation export/scoring after all four exact fit receipts pass, covering 1,873 validation sequences and 3,528,273 scored rows. No public-score gain is inferred from the exposed validation set.

The [receiving packet and byte-bound receipts](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/16a9ad1e2/research/experiment_drafts/transformer-qk-normalization-20261109/receiving/README.md) preserve the authority, profile/admission, launch, last-snapshot, and readout-waiter evidence. The first-profile clock and fit/wave cutoffs remain unchanged.
